_comment: The vibeic org's forked open-source EDA tools + their upstream sources. Discovered from the vibeic GitHub org (fork=true, parent recorded). This is the registry the fork-gatekeeper tracks.

forks.role: ALIGN sky130 PDK — carries our channel-length (L) and width (W) sizing fixes; ships in the image since 0.2.27, and the build fails unless a layout generated at L=500nm measures 500nm
analog place & route — SPICE netlist to GDS; ships in the image since 0.2.27 as the venv at /foss/tools/align, built from source rather than installed from PyPI
waveform viewer — the format reader behind every VCD/FST our cocotb and iverilog runs emit; a dump this cannot open is a failed measurement, not a passing one
place / route / CTS / resize / STA / PDN / antenna / IR-drop
static timing analysis — the signoff timing engine behind phase-3 STA (clean fork, no patches of ours yet)
SystemVerilog front end — yosys vendors it for the modern SV path, so an elaboration it rejects is an RTL our synthesis cannot read
yosys SystemVerilog plugin (upstream renamed povik/yosys-slang -> povik/sv-elab); the SV frontend the 0.4x->0.66 roadmap makes default
schematic capture and SPICE netlisting — the analog A1/A2 entry point; its netlist is what ngspice simulates
parallel SPICE — the second analog engine; a corner ngspice and Xyce disagree on is a result neither has established
SMT solver — the default smtbmc engine for sby, so step-5 formal proofs resolve through it; #13 was a dangling link to exactly this
